Parametric Running-Bond Brick Wall (Geometry Nodes)

`scene.blend` contains an empty mesh object `Wall` at the origin.

Add a live Geometry Nodes modifier to `Wall` and save the result as `answer.blend`. Do not apply the modifier; `Wall.data` must stay empty.

The node group must expose modifier inputs `Rows=6`, `Cols=8`, `Brick Dimensions=(0.2, 0.1, 0.05)` in meters, and `Gap=0.01`. The evaluated mesh must be a 6x8 running-bond wall of 48 disjoint cuboid bricks, each brick remaining an 8-vertex\6-face cuboid. The wall must have the expected overall dimensions, with the bottom at `z=0`, the left edge at `x=0`, and every odd row shifted by `(brick.x + gap) \ 2` relative to the row below.
